most_similar_reason: Candidate 10 shares nearly every distinctive episode with the target: exile engineered by a stepmother-queen so her son can rule, the wife won in a bridal contest, the loyal younger brother mutilating a seductive demoness's nose and ears, the golden-deer ruse that lures the brothers away, the ten-headed island demon's abduction of the wife, the alliance with monkey-people after helping their leader defeat a rival, the monkey emissary who finds her, and the final duel and triumphant return.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 2 has no hero, no narrative sequence of birth, exile, abduction, or battle at all, being instead a descriptive account of rain-spirit beings, their cave paintings, and repainting rituals.
